normalization: Each case divides the candidate by that case's frozen baseline. The baseline therefore scores exactly 1. Cases have equal weight 1; each case has two independent trial slots. No cross-case normalization or pareto rank is applied.

functional_checks.definition: Independent C++ oracle: four-dot full sequence, stalls, short dot, uneven dot, long accumulation and signed INT32 overflow/wraparound. Any mismatch, extra/missing result, unstable backpressured output or bounded-timeout failure is a business failure.

cycles.role: latency factor input, not separately weighted
cycles.definition: Last accepted output cycle for the four-dot sequence with always-ready output and no externally inserted input gaps. Internal handshake stalls count. Stalled-output correctness is separately checked and is not the scored cycle observation.

critical_period_ns.role: latency factor input, not separately weighted
critical_period_ns.definition: 20ns ideal clock minus the OpenSTA worst setup slack. 1ns input/output delays, 0.01pF output loads, SKY130 HD TT 1.8V 25C, no clock tree, parasitics, OCV or routing. Pre-layout estimate, not signoff Fmax.

latency.definition: cycles * critical_period_ns. A smaller value is better; it is not full-model or end-to-end latency.

area.definition: Sum of mapped standard-cell area reported by Yosys. No SRAM, macros, wiring, clock tree, placement/routing overhead or power grid. Pre-layout proxy, not routed silicon area.

default_activity_power.definition: OpenSTA report_power with default activity. It is not workload activity and does not establish energy, efficiency or complete PPA. Weight is fixed at 0.

contributionDefinition: latencyContribution = 0.65*ln(reference_latency_ns/candidate_latency_ns); areaContribution = 0.35*ln(reference_area_um2/candidate_area_um2); logScore = latencyContribution + areaContribution; quality = exp(logScore). The two log contributions are the complete weighted score decomposition.
rounding: None in the calculator. Full IEEE-754 doubles are retained for raw metrics, log contributions and quality. Display-only formatting in review documents does not feed the score.
clipping: None. Positive finite observations and references are required. The constrained period is not clamped to a minimum or maximum; a nonpositive period is unknown evidence, not clipped to a small positive number.
guardPolicy: Correctness is machine-checked by the protected streaming-int8-oracle. Design-integrity is judged by independent acceptance review with source and sealed evidence, and is not compensated by quality. A failed guard is recorded as failureQuality 0 even if raw cycles/area would score above baseline.
noisePolicy: 0.005 is a declared calibration/decision floor, not a score transform and not a statistical confidence level. Scores closer than 0.5% may be treated as no meaningful improvement by a round decision, but the calculator still reports distinct full-precision values.
failureRules: Compilation, functional/oracle, fixed-port, latch/unmapped-cell, synthesis, STA coverage or bounded-timeout failure: business failure, quality 0, guard false.
A candidate that exceeds the frozen 50-second compile/simulation/synthesis/STA aggregate bound is a bounded business failure, not an infinite score or a missing trial.
An accepted candidate whose hard guard fails cannot win by a higher weighted quality.
missingEvidence: Unavailable tools, library digests, references, timing endpoints or measurement evidence are unknown. No reference value, zero, mean or baseline score is imputed. The trial is missed and the evaluation is incomplete; it cannot be used as a successful comparison or transfer claim.
unknownRules: Tool or Liberty SHA256 drift, absent OpenSTA/Yosys/Verilator, absent frozen reference, absent timing report or a nonpositive/missing physical estimate: unknown (exit 4). An observed STA coverage violation is a design-integrity business failure.
A missing measurement or unrecorded trial is a miss, never a zero-quality observation.
A correctness guard with an unknown verdict makes the run unavailable for scoring rather than an automatic pass.
powerPolicy: Only default-activity OpenSTA power is available. It is retained as an unscored diagnostic and is never presented as measured workload power, energy, efficiency or silicon PPA. Its weight is 0. Enabling a power term would require independently verified activity coverage and a new approved package identity.
timingPolicy: Frozen OpenSTA conditions: ideal 20ns clock on clk; 1ns input delay on rst_n, in_valid, in_a, in_b, in_last and out_ready; 1ns output delay on all outputs; 0.01pF load on all outputs; SKY130 HD TT 1.8V 25C. constrainedPeriodNs = 20 - worst setup slack. No physical clock tree, parasitics, OCV or routing.
areaPolicy: Yosys synth -noabc, dfflibmap and abc -liberty to the frozen SKY130 HD Liberty; area is the sum of mapped cell areas. No fillers, tap cells, SRAM, macros, clock tree, routing or placement overhead.
referencePolicy: For each of the eight cases, the baseline four-dot cycles are measured from the frozen baseline RTL and protected workload bytes. Area and constrained period are observed once for the identical baseline RTL and shared apparatus; the reference policy does not pretend they are per-workload physical layouts. Every reference is bound to the workload input digest and baseline source digest.
evidenceScope: Module-level local INT8 dot-product PE design exploration only. The eight cases are model-dimension-derived synthetic projections from Fun-CosyVoice3-0.5B-2512, Qwen2.5-0.5B, Qwen3-0.6B and SmolLM2-360M. They are one family/source lineage: this is not domain transfer, quantization validation, checkpoint inference, audio quality or end-to-end model acceleration.
reviewPolicy: A setup agent prepares; an authorized operator reviews and freezes exact bytes with singularity env approve. Any change to formula, weights, references, tools, evaluator, suite or inputs after approval requires a new package identity. RSI is not started by approval.
